name: Hanko Stamp
description: A press-and-hold confirm control that charges, then brings a seal down and leaves a red impression.

props.name: label
props.description: Button text before stamping. It is also the accessible name, so say that it needs holding.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Button text after stamping, also announced politely to assistive technology.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long to hold, by pointer or with Space or Enter. A water ring fills round the control and the stamp lowers; letting go early drains it.

props.name: onStamp
props.description: Called once when the seal comes down.

props.name: mark
props.description: One or two characters for the seal, set in the inherited font; a name with spaces becomes its initials, and two CJK characters stack vertically. Without it the seal carries a drawn snow-crystal crest that needs no font.

props.name: shape
props.description: Outline of the seal. Every press gives a slightly different impression: uneven border, patchy ink, and a turn of 1.5 to 6.5 degrees either way.

props.name: sealSize
props.description: Width and height of the impression in pixels.

props.name: sealClassName
props.description: Classes for the impression. By default it sits beside the button. The wrapper is not positioned, so absolute classes such as "absolute top-4 right-4" place it on the nearest positioned ancestor, like the corner of a card.

props.name: ref
props.description: Exposes reset(), which lifts the seal and returns the control to its first label.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper, an inline flex row. Other div props are passed through. Under reduced motion the ring still fills and the seal fades in without falling.
